limitations.worker_launch: The required explicit prepare -> provision sequence was refused by the lab helper because the prepare tripwire already existed; teardown succeeded. tmux is not on PATH. Portable tests executed real emitted launch commands against synthetic panes, not a live worker.
limitations.bun_launch_server: Guarded Bun launchServer/connect stalled. The unguarded headless:true control also stalled for 60 seconds; no guard-specific failure established. All timed-out processes were gone at cleanup.
limitations.electron_opt_out: Portable behavioral tests only; no native Electron executable available on PATH, and visible-window opt-out not exercised against a real GUI.
